test_title: PYST 1: SSC Stenographer - Reasoning (Held On:17 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Three statements are given followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some telescopes are periscopes.

Some telescopes are microscopes.

Some telescopes are kaleidoscopes.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some kaleidoscopes are telescopes.

II. Some microscopes are kaleidoscopes.

III. Some microscopes are telescopes.

options.text: Only conclusions I and III follow
Only conclusions II and III follow

solution:
The least possible venn diagram for the given statement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7573a205f14d0f99cf7fd2ad0c255f4074fc92cb534f6a9a709190ebe6138dfa.png] 

Conclusions:

 
• Some kaleidoscopes are telescopes.- **True **(Because Some telescopes are kaleidoscopes)
 
• Some microscopes are kaleidoscopes** - **False (There is no direct relation given between microscopes and kaleidoscope)
 
• Some microscopes are telescopes - **True **(because Some telescopes are microscopes**)**

 

So, Only conclusions I and III follow.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2".**
